instance_description:
Setting: A 2026 city waste-reduction ambassador program in Glenmere, Ohio, run through the public works department, reuse center, apartment outreach network, and community workshop rooms.
Scope: Recurring activities include recycling table shifts, compost-bin orientations, repair-clinic support, waste-sorting observations, reusable-dish kit checkout, resident survey summaries, school-event preparation, and neutral public-service outreach.
Resources: Empty reusable structures hold protagonist context, civic engagements, shared materials, workshop outlines, outreach drafts, and waste-audit notes for later Scenario initialization.
Exclusions: This Instance excludes enforcement, sanitation operations, private party planning, environmental legal interpretation, hazardous-material handling, partisan campaigning, and native app state such as calendars, email, or task lists.
personal_description:
Identity: Oona Beatrice Halek is a 34-year-old Glenmere resident and unpaid lead volunteer for the Waste Wise Ambassadors, using her full name as user_id in records.
Responsibilities: She coordinates volunteer-facing records, prepares neutral resident education materials, tracks reusable outreach supplies, summarizes observations, and supports approved public works workshops.
Authority: She may draft nonpartisan communications, organize ambassador logistics, maintain program notes, and spend only personally authorized funds from her own wallet.
Restrictions: She cannot issue citations, direct city crews, certify environmental compliance, handle hazardous waste, access utility accounts, promise service changes, or campaign for candidates or ballot measures.
